title: Finite-Dimensional Recursions for Small-Noise Expansions in Nonlinear Filtering
summary: This paper provides a recursive formula for computing the coefficients in a small-system-noise asymptotic expansion for nonlinear filtering. The expansion, obtained from the Kallianpur--Striebel formula, was justified in the author's previous work. Our main contribution is to reduce the coefficient calculation to a finite-dimensional system extending the Kalman--Bucy filter by applying Fubini's theorem and Wick's formula and differentiating the resulting terms.
